messages:
Maya: FYI nightly eval just flagged a 4.7% drop in intent F1 for pset20 after the v20 prompt split went in. Not subtle — several customer-facing intents are worse. :alarm_clock:

eval-bot: nightly-evals finished for main/nightly at 2025-11-06T07:04:28Z. Summary: pset20: intent F1 -4.7% (CI 0.9%), examples failed 23/500. Top regressions: billing.get_invoice, auth.reset_link, search.rank_intent. Full diff: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/1935802468

Maya: copying a couple quick examples below (bad generations). These came straight from the failing rows: 

```
Prompt: "How do I reset my password?"
Model vX (baseline): "You can reset your password by following the reset link sent to your email. If you didn't receive it, check spam."
Model vY (new): "Reset link expired. Please contact support to reset."

Prompt: "Show me last month's invoice"
Model vX: "Here is your invoice for 2025-10 (amount: $312.45). Download: https://..."
Model vY: "I can't access invoices right now. Try again later."
```

Maya: those are examples where the new prompt split seems to push the model toward conservative failure modes (safe denials) instead of returning structured info.

Li: quick diff of the prompt change — we split 'account inquiry' prompt into two shorter templates and added explicit user-intent clarifiers. It *should* help disambiguation but might reduce generative context for system instructions. Patch: `git rev: a1c3f4 -> b2d5e6` (PR #2319).

Arun: I can reproduce locally on the quantized variant (int8). Weird: baseline fp16 doesn't show as big a delta. Could be interaction between prompt split and quantized tokenization context lengths. Running targeted eval on the quantized canary now.

Zoe: Can we avoid a full rebaseline? Ops wants a quick mitigation path (rollback prompt split) + a small re-eval on a focused set of pset20 examples. I prefer rollback + hotfix to preserve upstream metrics, then follow up with a careful rebaseline if needed. :thumbsup:

Noa: product perspective — any rollback will need sign-off from ML lead + Data QA because this was intentional wording to reduce hallucinations. We need a short checklist before reverting: 1) reproduce locally, 2) confirm rollback improves failing intents, 3) check no new hallucination spike.

Arun: checklist status: 1) reproduced on quantized canary (yes), 2) running rollback diff locally now (should be quick), 3) running hallucination probe set (started). ETA ~30m.

Li: quick note — the prompt split also trimmed an instruction token that the tokenizer treats differently in int8. I opened a small follow-up on tokenizer normalization in the PR comments. If delta disappears on fp16 but persists on int8, this points there.

mergebot: PR #2319 was merged by Li into main at 2025-11-06T06:42:11Z. CI: passed.

Maya: Suggested immediate plan: 1) Arun rolls a rollback patch to main (revert PR #2319) behind a canary flag, 2) run targeted nightly for pset20 + hallucination probe on both fp16 and int8 variants, 3) convene quick sync in 45m with ML lead + QA. Is everyone ok?

Zoe: ok from my side.

Li: ok, I can draft the rollback and a corrected split that preserves the instruction token.

Noa: please capture all diffs and metrics in the ticket (TICKET-4821). I'll coordinate with support comms if we need to message customers.

Arun: rollback patch created and deployed to canary pool `canary-quant-1`. Running evals now. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/rollback-1935802468

eval-bot: targeted-evals complete on canary-quant-1. Results: pset20 intent F1 back up +3.9% vs main-with-split; hallucination probe delta neutral. Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/rollback-1935802468/logs

Maya: great — looks like rollback helps on quantized. Next step: if rollback is safe, let's schedule a short canary promotion to dedicated staging for 2 hours then merge the follow-up tokenizer fix before re-applying the split.

Noa: please add sign-offs to the PR (ML lead + QA). I'll be in the sync in 25m.

Zoe: +1 from product to proceed with rollback canary promotion once ML lead signs.

Li: drafting corrected split now; I'll include tokenizer normalization and a minimal reword so the instruction token isn't lost.

Maya: thanks everyone. I'll update TICKET-4821 with links and the action items. If anyone finds additional failing classes, drop them here. :eyes:
